title: Handling Disagreement
goal: By the end of the lesson, you can disagree without sounding cold and keep the conversation moving.

items.speaker: A
items.text: Have you spoken to Emma recently?

items.speaker: B
items.text: Not really. We've both had __________, so we slowly __________.

items.speaker: A
items.text: That's a shame. Why don't you __________ to her?

items.speaker: B
items.text: I want to, but I'm worried the conversation might feel awkward.

items.speaker: A
items.text: You could ask her to meet for coffee and __________.

items.speaker: B
items.text: Good idea. I need to __________ the people I care about.

items.speaker: A
items.text: Exactly. You can still __________ even when life gets busy.

vocab.text: Đáp án: a lot going on · drifted apart · reach out · catch up · make time for · keep in touch. Làm một mình trước, sau đó so sánh bằng lời nói. Pair practice: đọc 1 lần, rồi thay Emma bằng người thật và đổi ít nhất 2 chi tiết. Thêm 2 câu nối tiếp: Who is the person? · Why did you lose touch? · What would you say first?

items.q: I ______ you about the price. It is too expensive.
I ______ that idea because it would create more work.
You ______. We should check the details before deciding.
I can ______, but I still feel differently.
'Is working from home always easier?' '______. It depends on your home.'

vocab.text: Đáp án: 1 agree with · 2 disagree with · 3 have a point · 4 see your point · 5 Not necessarily. Giải thích 1 đáp án bằng lý do của bạn.
Meaning, pronunciation, and form · Different views
Đọc disagree với trọng âm ở âm tiết cuối. Drill necessarily chậm trước, rồi tốc độ tự nhiên. 5-second drill: giáo viên đưa 1 ý. Học viên chọn 1 cách đáp và thêm 1 lý do.
Vocabulary in context · Solving the problem

We disagree, but I'm sure we can ______ together.
Neither option is perfect. We may need to ______.

vocab.text: Đáp án: 1 bring it up · 2 work it out · 3 compromise · 4 change my mind · 5 open to.
Meaning, pronunciation, and form · Solving the problem
Complete aloud: I'm open to ______ing. We could compromise on ______.
Chú ý open to + V-ing, KHÔNG dùng to + động từ nguyên thể. Compromise nhấn âm tiết đầu.

vocab.text: Drill với ngữ điệu ấm và tông xuống-lên ở 'I'm not sure'. Sau đó học viên làm mềm 3 câu trực tiếp mới từ giáo viên.

grammar.text: Answer building · More depth, still on topic

items.label: VIEW
items.text: I don't necessarily think friends should reply immediately.

items.label: REASON
items.text: Sometimes people are busy or need time to think.

items.label: DETAIL
items.text: For example, a thoughtful reply may be better than a quick one.

items.label: BALANCE
items.text: However, if the message is urgent, they should respond as soon as possible.

items.label: RETURN
items.text: What do you think?

grammar.text: Một câu trả lời hoàn chỉnh có thể là 2, 3, hoặc 4 câu. Dừng khi ý đã rõ. Xây câu trả lời thứ hai cùng nhau: People should never discuss serious issues by text.

head: Cấu trúc
Ví dụ
rows: I think that the plan is too expensive. · I don't agree that everyone needs to join.
A friend who listens calmly is easier to talk to. · The option that costs less may be better.
It's difficult to stay calm. · I'm happy to consider another option.
She explained her view calmly. · We eventually found a solution.

grammar.text: Cho 1 câu cơ bản như 'The plan is bad.' Học viên nâng cấp bằng MỘT cấu trúc duy nhất. Tránh xếp chồng mọi cấu trúc vào một câu.

head: Nhóm
Câu hỏi nối tiếp
rows: What do you mean by that? · Could you give an example?
What makes you feel that way? · Why do you think so?
Which matters more to you: time, money, or comfort?
What would be a fair compromise?

grammar.text: Rule · Understand the reason before defending your view.
Đối tác hỏi 2 câu nối tiếp từ 2 nhóm khác nhau trước khi đưa ý kiến của mình.

reading.text: Chọn 1 ý. Nêu quan điểm trong 2–4 câu. Đối tác phản hồi. Nghe trước, phản hồi 1 điểm trước khi thêm ý của bạn.

items: It's okay to cancel plans at the last minute.
Living alone is better than sharing a home.

reading.text: Speak from the dialogue · Chọn 1 quyết định

Thảo luận 2 phút và đi đến kết quả. Cho 30 giây chuẩn bị im lặng, sau đó 2 phút không ngắt lời. Dùng ít nhất 3 cụm: I see your point · You have a point · I'm open to… · Could we compromise? · Let's compare…

items: a hotel for a short trip
how to travel to another city
how much to spend on a gift

reading.text: Chọn 2 ý. Trả lời tập trung. Đối tác phản hồi vào LÝ DO của bạn. Mỗi lượt trao đổi kéo dài khoảng 90 giây gồm cả câu nối tiếp.

items: People should avoid difficult conversations by text.
It's better to be honest than polite.
Couples should share every expense equally.
Friends do not need to agree on important issues.

reading.text: Try: Not necessarily… · I see your point, but… · That depends on… · You have a point.
Problem-solving circle · One issue, one result

items: A colleague plays music while working.

reading.text: Dùng nhóm 3 người nếu có thể: 2 người nói và 1 người quan sát. Người quan sát nghe: ngôn ngữ tôn trọng · lý do rõ ràng · một quyết định thật.

conversations.title: A weekend plan
conversations.target: I see your point · I'm open to · work it out
conversations.lift: right in the city centre · save us a lot of time
conversations.question: Listen once for the main idea. What do Mia and Alex disagree about, and how do they solve it?

lines.speaker: Mia
lines.text: I found a great hotel for our weekend trip. It's right in the city centre.

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.text: It looks nice, but I don't think we should spend that much.

lines.speaker: Mia
lines.text: Really? I think the location will save us a lot of time.

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.text: I see your point, but we'll only be there for two nights.

lines.speaker: Mia
lines.text: True, although I don't want to stay somewhere uncomfortable.

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.text: Neither do I. We could find a cheaper place nearby.

lines.speaker: Mia
lines.text: You have a point. What price range do you have in mind?

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.text: Maybe something under two million a night. Would that work?

lines.speaker: Mia
lines.text: Possibly. I'm open to staying outside the centre if the transport is good.

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.text: Fair enough. We can compare travel time as well as price.

lines.speaker: Mia
lines.text: Okay. Let's each choose two places and look at them tonight.

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.text: Perfect. I'm sure we can work it out.

check: Why does Mia prefer the first hotel?
How does Alex show that he understands Mia?
Which line shows that Mia becomes flexible?
Whose suggestion seems more reasonable to you? Why?
conversations.answers: location saves time · under two million · I see your point · I'm open to staying outside the centre
conversations.note: Phát audio đầy đủ với lời thoại che trước. Lần 2: hiện slide. Sau đó chia vai. Các cụm được đánh dấu là cách bất đồng lịch sự và giải quyết vấn đề.

conversations.title: A shared apartment
conversations.target: bring something up · work it out · sound reasonable
conversations.question: Listen for the problem and the solution. What was bothering Nina, and what solution did they agree on?

lines.speaker: Nina
lines.text: Ben, can I bring something up? The kitchen has been quite messy lately.

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: I know. Work has been exhausting, so I haven't cleaned much this week.

lines.speaker: Nina
lines.text: I understand, but I can't keep doing all of it by myself.

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: That's fair. I didn't realise you were doing most of the cleaning.

lines.speaker: Nina
lines.text: I didn't say anything because I wanted to avoid an argument.

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: I wish you had told me earlier. We could have worked it out.

lines.speaker: Nina
lines.text: You're right. Could we make a simple cleaning schedule?

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: I'm open to that, although I don't want it to be too strict.

lines.speaker: Nina
lines.text: Fair enough. How about we each choose the jobs we don't mind doing?

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: That sounds reasonable. I can cook and take out the rubbish.

lines.speaker: Nina
lines.text: Great. I'll do the shopping, and we can share the rest.

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Deal. If something bothers us, let's bring it up sooner.

check: What problem does Nina bring up?
Why hasn't Ben cleaned much this week?
Why did Nina avoid talking about the problem earlier?
What solution do they finally agree on?
What exact phrase does Nina use to introduce the problem politely?
Which three short responses help reduce the tension?
conversations.answers: 1 The kitchen has been messy and Nina has been doing most of the cleaning. · 2 Work has been exhausting. · 3 She wanted to avoid an argument. · 4 They agree to make a flexible schedule, choose jobs they do not mind, and bring up future problems sooner. · 5 Can I bring something up? · 6 That's fair; I'm open to that; Fair enough / That sounds reasonable.
conversations.note: Lần nghe 1: che lời thoại và xác định vấn đề. Lần 2: hiện slide. Sau đó đọc theo vai với tông bình tĩnh, xây dựng. KHÔNG hiện transcript trước khi hỏi các câu trên.

roleplay.title: House rules
roleplay.context: Two people share a home but have different habits.
steps: A: You need quiet after 10 p.m. Bring the issue up calmly.
B: You often call friends late. Explain why.
A: Respond to B's reason and suggest one rule.
B: Disagree with one detail and offer another option.
BOTH: Compromise on quiet hours and exceptions.
roleplay.useful: bring it up · I understand, but… · I'm open to… · Could we compromise?

roleplay.title: A group plan
roleplay.context: Two friends are planning a birthday for someone else.
steps: A: Prefer a quiet dinner because the person dislikes crowds.
B: Prefer a surprise party because it feels more memorable.
A: Explain one risk and acknowledge B's good point.
B: Ask a clarifying question and adjust your idea.
BOTH: Choose a plan, budget, and one next step.
roleplay.useful: I'm not sure I agree · You have a point · I'm open to… · Could we compromise?

finalTask.text: Choose one real-life decision on which you may disagree. State your view and explain why. Acknowledge one point from your partner. Ask at least two follow-up questions. Agree on a compromise or explain why you cannot agree yet.
Mục tiêu: bất đồng với Ý TƯỞNG, không công kích NGƯỜI. Ghi âm nếu học viên đồng ý. Feedback nêu 1 cách đáp thành công, 1 phần mở rộng hữu ích, và 1 mục tiêu ngôn ngữ.
Describe a disagreement that ended well. What helped? Include: the issue · both views · one useful response · the final solution.
Choose 8 items from L03. Make one true or realistic sentence with each.
Chỉ dùng từ khóa. Không viết và học thuộc cả script. L04 (Setting Boundaries) sẽ bắt đầu bằng một đoạn hội thoại ngắn recycle L03.
